title: Noise Level Robustness
caption: Left: balanced accuracy by PP-08 quality group for each experiment, averaged over that experiment's models and folds -- observational, and the groups differ in more than noise. Right: the same PhysioNet recordings at 20/15/10/5/0 dB added white Gaussian noise, scored by a model refitted without their subjects; dotted lines mark the untouched control. Additive white noise is a laboratory stressor and not a model of real stethoscope contamination.
dataset: D1 PhysioNet 2016, D2/D3 PASCAL, D4 CirCor 2022
